lines.t: You speak in the hush of morning, a whisper drifting through the light.
I am making all things new, you say
And the shadows begin to melt from sight
For the kingdom comes in quiet steps
And nothing will remain the same
Every tear you gather, every heart you mend
You lift the broken from the dust and make them whole again
Behold the kingdom coming, a dawn without an end
Where sorrow cannot follow and peace is born again
Your light falls on the nations and every fear is gone
The new earth rises in Your love, O Lord, forever strong
You walk beside the humble, you call the weary home
You plant the gardens of the new world, where living waters flow
And all creation listens, the trees lift up their hands
For the Son of Glory speaks again, and healing covers every land
You are the God who dwells with men
Of pain and loss and death
In the brightness of Your presence
We rise to see the new earth bloom
The new earth sings beneath your feet
And we belong to You forever
The new earth sings beneath your feet
Oh Lord, You make all things new
and we belong to You forever.
